scope: Replacement multi-adaptor console, local visual companion, new Godot/Aseprite adaptors and bounded FreeCAD extensions

frontendPureTests.scope: Pick/projection math, clipping, pixels, revision identity, draft persistence; not a browser or native application substitute

checks: Actual native execution and image preview for every provider
Native FCStd, blend, pvsm and aseprite saves; Godot retains its complete project bundle
FreeCAD, Blender and ParaView retain their native process across edits and document switches
Edited documents cannot save an older checkpoint as current native output
Session recovery preserves authored documents and checkpoints but does not pretend to recover running native clients

nativeQualification.copiedEvidenceNote: Godot/Aseprite copied receipts may retain original /tmp paths; the five-provider integration evidence was created directly at its retained repository path.

actualBrowserChecks.surface: In-app browser through computer-use automation; actual loopback server and native FreeCAD model
checks: Face pick at preserved text caret, native edge and vertex references
Backspace removes one complete reference; @ menu reuses it
Mixed digest-bound image pixel and native face references save together
Saved request and draft recover after page reload
Model edit marks old chips stale and blocks submission
Constrained sketch displays zero triangles, four native edges and four vertices; edge reference saves
Orbit and zoom change the rendered view; perspective walk and X-section controls work
Cancel during actual FreeCAD startup returns RUNNER_CANCELLED; subsequent preview succeeds with retained document
Final desktop layout bounds command output instead of stretching the geometry pane

limits: This is bounded functionality, not exhaustive application parity or production-scale certification.
Arbitrary natural-language requests are retained structured intent, not executed instructions.
Native GUI edits are not reverse-synchronised into authored documents.
Native model subelement references are revision-scoped; image pixels do not infer native object or layer identity.
Godot and Aseprite use native batch sessions, not persistent interactive workers.
Live Blender/ParaView support one resolved scene/state and serial local execution. ParaView state files may depend on external datasets.
Live checkpoint integrity is distinct from independent native reopening; per-checkpoint scope is disclosed.
FreeCAD assemblies are fixed-joint trees with bounded linked primitives, not general motion or collision simulation, and have no live assembly viewer yet.
Godot/Aseprite/assembly documents are standalone: workflow-scheduler composition explicitly rejects them pending a complete handoff contract.
CFD case-preparation, office-suite and browser adaptors remain deferred.
